item.title: 1.3.0-beta1
item.description:
What's Changed

  • Quick Notes: create, edit, persist, select, delete notes directly in the notch. PR #79.
    • HUD recovery: notch volume/brightness HUD re-enables after macOS sleep/wake or a long lock-screen period. PR #79.
    • Dependencies: Sparkle 2.10.0, KeyboardShortcuts 3.1.0, SwiftSyntax 604.0.0, SwiftUI-Introspect 27.0.0. PRs #74–#77.
    • CI only: Dependabot updates merge after Build + CodeQL succeed. PR #80.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/jinkun1998/another.notch/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0-beta1

anotherNotch v1.2.0

New Features

  • Music lyrics — synced lyrics below music controls, with verified lyric matching.
  • Lunar calendar — Vietnamese lunar dates in Calendar.
  • Tab shortcuts — global keyboard shortcuts for installed notch modules.
  • Clipboard improvements — paste selected records into the active app; preview long content.
  • System HUD controls — choose which macOS HUDs anotherNotch replaces.
  • Update check — menu bar action to manually check for updates.
  • Homebrew Cask — install anotherNotch from Homebrew.

Optimizations

  • Reduced open-notch redraw work for music lyrics, progress, and waveform effects.
  • Smoother notch resizing and stable music-control positioning.
  • Improved notch sizing options consistency across display types.
